# 🧰 Maintenance Checklist

## Repository health

- [ ] Default branch and latest commit inspected.
- [ ] Open issues and pull requests reviewed.
- [ ] README, documentation index, and project tree are accurate.
- [ ] Internal Markdown links resolve.
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams still match the code.
- [ ] SVG assets include accessible title and description.

## Dependencies and supply chain

- [ ] Dependabot updates reviewed.
- [ ] npm outdated inspected.
- [ ] npm audit reviewed.
- [ ] Lockfile consistency verified.
- [ ] Package licenses and provenance reviewed.
- [ ] Active picomatch advisory status rechecked.

## Quality

- [ ] npm ci
- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] npm run docs:check, if available
- [ ] Browser smoke test for UI changes

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets or private transcripts committed.
- [ ] GitHub workflow permissions remain least privilege.
- [ ] External requests and data flow are documented.
- [ ] Security reporting route works.
- [ ] No unsupported compliance claims added.

## Project planning

- [ ] Roadmap reflects approved priorities.
- [ ] Known issues and technical debt are current.
- [ ] Release and rollback plans are usable.
- [ ] Owners are assigned to active risks.

## Record

Maintainer, review date, commit, findings, follow-up owners, and next review date:
